findings.summary: Replacing the `[[ -z $comp ]] && continue` check with `[[ $comp == "$cur"* ]] || continue` drops the skip for empty completions, so blank or tab-only lines are added to COMPREPLY when $cur is empty and can break the single-completion check that follows.

judge.reason: Identifies that the new prefix test no longer skips empty completions, so an empty entry is added when $cur is empty.
